description: This PHP class 'LangStringHelper' provides utility functions for managing language strings within the OrangeHRM system, including database interactions for retrieving, inserting, updating, and deleting language string records, as well as reading language strings from YAML files.

classes.name: LangStringHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing language strings within the database, including CRUD operations and reading from YAML files.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the helper with a database connection.

methods.name: createQueryBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new Doctrine QueryBuilder instance.

methods.name: getLangHelper
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns a LanguageHelper instance.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID for a language group given its name.

methods.name: deleteNonCustomizedLangStrings
methods.description: Deletes language strings that are not marked as customized for a given group.

methods.name: getLangStringIdsForGroup
methods.description: Fetches all language string IDs for a specific group.

methods.name: getNonCustomizedLangStringIds
methods.description: Fetches language string IDs that are non-customized within a group.

methods.name: insertOrUpdateLangStrings
methods.description: Reads language strings from a YAML file and inserts or updates them in the database.

methods.name: getLangStringIdByValueAndGroup
methods.description: Finds a language string ID by its value and optional group ID.

methods.name: getLangStringIdByUnitIdAndGroup
methods.description: Finds a language string ID by unit ID and group ID.

methods.name: saveLangString
methods.description: Inserts a new language string record into the database.

methods.name: updateLangString
methods.description: Updates an existing language string record in the database.
